prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original game loading-screen background, fully opaque landscape image, 1536x1024.
Primary request: premium illustrated loading background for the existing fantasy cooking card battler Emberpan: Midnight Service. Preserve its playful dark-fantasy midnight-kitchen identity and cooking/ingredient combat theme.
Scene/backdrop: a mysterious cozy stone kitchen at midnight, big copper pots and a warm ember-fired stove in the back, blue moonlight through a tall window, wooden pantry shelves with herbs, mushrooms and pickling jars.
Subject: an original confident chef with rolled sleeves and apron prepares a pan at the left-middle; on the upper-right side, a mischievous small pickle imp, mushroom creature and dough golem peek from ingredients and cookware. A subtle fan of completely blank-backed illustrated playing cards sits near the far left edge, showing only simple ingredient motifs without writing, demonstrating the card-battler theme. The chef and creatures are friendly-macabre rather than scary.
Style/medium: polished painterly 2D game key art, bold readable shapes, tactile copper/wood/stone, rich but controlled detail, original stylized character design.
Composition/framing: wide kitchen vista with chef, creatures, pots and stove in upper two-thirds and outer sides; the lower central third is an uncluttered dark wooden preparation counter with soft even shadow, reserved for live localized title/status/progress. Clear central negative space; no interface.
Lighting/mood: midnight indigo and plum shadows contrasted with warm amber hearth light and restrained ingredient greens.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark, no UI or status bar, no card frames covering the image, no Godot branding, no baked particle overlays, no copyrighted franchise characters. Opaque edge-to-edge image, not a screenshot.
processing: Aspect-preserving downscale to 1280px width; 256-color PNG boot image and quality-82 WebP embedded before PCK; no text baked into either image.
